validation: All immutable elements must match the locked coordinates.
Cover must include category, headline, subtitle, framed image, image caption, IL MECCANISMO box, signature and red CTA bar.
No free-form full-cover generation is permitted.
Only the central image may be generated or replaced.
The central image must pass the mandatory 12-cover visual uniqueness check.
Verify the complete composition at 390px before publication.

visual_uniqueness_policy.principle: The layout is uniform; the editorial image is unique to the specific event.
forbidden_reuse: the same crop of a previously used photograph
the same collage with only text or color changes
a visually equivalent composition dominated by the same people, ship, explosion, flags or skyline
required_before_render: Inspect the central images used in the previous 12 published covers.
Choose a subject that identifies the new event rather than its generic geopolitical theatre.
Record the source asset or generation prompt used for the new central image.
Reject the cover when its central image could be mistaken for any of the previous 12 covers at thumbnail size.
visual_uniqueness_policy.series_rule: An update to an existing dossier still requires a new central image when it is redistributed as a new Instagram or Telegram post.

topic_examples.hormuz: Rotate among the specific port, vessel, military asset, insurance or market actor documented by the update; do not default to a generic tanker or burning sea.
topic_examples.iran: Use the person, institution, bank, facility or operation central to the verified development; do not default to flags, missiles or generic Tehran imagery.
topic_examples.defence: Use the documented platform, factory, institution or procurement object; do not default to generic soldiers or NATO flags.
